title: Envy Isn't a Personality. It's a Sin to Kill.
caption:
"I'm just competitive" is what envy sounds like when you don't want to kill it yet.

The acts of the flesh are obvious: sexual immorality, impurity... envy... (Galatians 5:19-21). It's on the list. Not a quirk. A sin.

Trace it to what it actually says about what you believe about God. Then bless the guy who has what you want, out loud, before God.

Comparison keeps you in his chapter. Gratitude puts you back in yours.
